posts.title: The subconscious knew
posts.description: I've become accustomed to not immediately know why I do certain things. It's like the subconscious is making an investment that will be realized once I become conscious of what the subconscious knew all along.

posts.title: Spirituality is a Dinosaur
posts.description: Spirituality is a dinosaur who's ways has long since been forgotten and is something that has turned into an unevolving truth worshipped by the lost and exploited by consciously corrupted.

posts.title: Conscious Evolution: Life as an Interface for Knowing Ourselves
posts.description: A reflection on conscious evolution: life as an interface for self-knowing, plus three prompts to find your next conscious step.
